new_result.statement: For rank-exactly-three A=U Lambda U^T with exactly one heavy row c>1/2 and d=A_kk!=0, ||p_Q||_infinity <=4 sqrt(2e)(c|d||det Lambda|)^(-1/4). If |d|>=1/4 and |det Lambda|>=1, the bound is <15.69. Essential boundedness only; continuity not proved.
new_result.integrated_fourier_identity: For the rank-two residual R=Z^T S Z, int |t|^(-1/2)|phi_R(t)|dt <=8sqrt(e pi)|det S|^(-1/4), hence sup_s E|s-R|^(-1/2)<=4sqrt(2e)|det S|^(-1/4).
new_result.partner_application: Residual |d|<1/4 forces sigma>sqrt(7)/4 and therefore |phi_Q(t)| <=(4 pi sqrt(2)/sqrt(7))^(1/2)|t|^(-1/2).

unresolved_implication: QFORM-UNIQUE-HEAVY-CROSS-CLOSURE-v1: gain the missing additional half-order in the unique-heavy small-diagonal branch while preserving original-coordinate product structure; after that handle at least two heavy rows and arbitrary additional eigendirections.
